card.name: Inevitable Mutual Betrayal
card.power: Both players reveal their hands. The one with the lowest value loses everything. If tied, you both lose.
card.lore: We formed an alliance with the explicit intent of destroying each other. Why are you surprised?

line: Inevitable Mutual Betrayal, reveal hands, lowest loses everything; why are you surprised?
spokenText: Inevitable Mutual Betrayal, reveal hands, lowest loses everything; why are you surprised?

card.name: In the Back
card.power: Play only when an opponent leaves the room. Steal their best card.
card.lore: Cowards live longer. It's simple biology.

line: In the Back, Steal best card when opponent leaves; cowards live longer.
spokenText: Remember In the Back, Steal best card when opponent leaves; cowards live longer.

card.name: The Oath-Breaker
card.power: Cancel any "Promise" or "Alliance" made in the last 3 turns. Take 2 chips from the victim.
card.lore: Words are wind. Contracts are paper. Paper burns.

line: The Oath-Breaker, Cancel Promise or Alliance; words wind, paper burns.
spokenText: The Oath-Breaker, Cancel Promise or Alliance; words wind, paper burns.

card.name: False Friend
card.power: Look at an opponent's hand. Tell them you love them. Discard their highest card.
card.lore: They were only pretending to like your mixtape to get the nuclear codes.

line: False Friend, tell them you love them, discard their highest card.
spokenText: False Friend, tell them you love them, discard their highest card.

card.name: Properly Paranoid
card.power: Check the bottom card of the deck. If it's a Trap, scream. Keep the card.
card.lore: It's not paranoia if the universe is actually out to get you.

line: Properly Paranoid, Check bottom card; universe actually out to get you.
spokenText: You know Properly Paranoid, Check bottom card; universe actually out to get you.

card.name: Spies Are Despicable
card.power: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Put them back in the worst possible order.
card.lore: We hate them for lying. We pay them for the truth. We shoot them for receipt.

line: Spies Are Despicable, Worst possible order; hate spies for lying, pay for truth.
spokenText: Spies Are Despicable, Worst possible order; hate spies for lying, pay for truth.

card.name: Betrayal Insurance
card.power: If a player steals from you, you may immediately steal two items from them.
card.lore: I knew you'd turn on me, so I poisoned your coffee three weeks ago.

line: Betrayal Insurance, steal two items; poisoned your coffee three weeks ago.
spokenText: Betrayal Insurance, steal two items; poisoned your coffee three weeks ago.

card.name: Chronic Backstabbing Disorder
card.power: You MUST betray an ally this turn. If you have no ally, betray yourself (discard 2 cards).
card.lore: It's a compulsion. Like sneezing, but with more knives.

line: Chronic Backstabbing Disorder, must betray ally? Like sneezing, but with more knives.
spokenText: What if Chronic Backstabbing Disorder, must betray ally? Like sneezing, but with more knives.

card.name: The Starscream
card.power: Challenge the current leader. If you lose, apologize profusely and draw 1 card.
card.lore: Standard operating procedure: Grovel to the face, plot against the back.

line: The Starscream, challenge leader, if you lose, apologize; grovel to face, plot against back.
spokenText: The Starscream, challenge leader, if you lose, apologize; grovel to face, plot against back.

card.name: The Yes-Man
card.power: Copy the action of the player to your right. Do it worse.
card.lore: I agree with whatever you just said, sir, especially the part that contradicts what you said yesterday.

line: The Yes-Man, Copy action, do it worse; agree with what you said yesterday.
spokenText: The Yes-Man, Copy action, do it worse; agree with what you said yesterday.

card.name: Stealing the Credit
card.power: Take a card someone else just played. Put it in your score pile. It's yours now.
card.lore: I made this. (I did not make this).

line: Stealing the Credit, take card someone else played; it's yours now. I made this.
spokenText: Anyway, Stealing the Credit, take card someone else played; it's yours now. I made this.

card.name: Bastard Understudy
card.power: If a player is eliminated, take their seat and their hand.
card.lore: Break a leg. Seriously. I have a crowbar.

line: Bastard Understudy, Eliminated player, take seat and hand; break a leg, crowbar.
spokenText: Bastard Understudy, Eliminated player, take seat and hand; break a leg, crowbar.

card.name: The Coup
card.power: Overthrow the player with the most points. Swap point totals with them.
card.lore: Look at me. I am the Captain now. Until the Lemurs get hungry.

line: The Coup, Overthrow player with most points; Captain now until Lemurs hungry.
spokenText: The Coup, Overthrow player with most points; Captain now until Lemurs hungry.

card.name: The Puppet Master
card.power: Force another player to make a move of your choice.
card.lore: Dance, little fly. The web was never about catching you; it was about employment.

line: The Puppet Master, force another player's move; dance, little fly.
spokenText: No wait, The Puppet Master, force another player's move; dance, little fly.

card.name: I Can Rule Alone
card.power: Break an alliance. Take all shared resources. Lose 1 turn because you are now lonely.
card.lore: The partnership is dissolved. Also, you are dissolved.

line: I Can Rule Alone, break alliance, take shared resources; lose turn, you are now lonely.
spokenText: I Can Rule Alone, break alliance, take shared resources; lose turn, you are now lonely.

card.name: Board to Death
card.power: Call a meeting. Everyone gives you 1 card. If they refuse, they lose 1 life.
card.lore: This meeting could have been an email, but then I wouldn't get to eat you.

line: Board to Death, Meeting: everyone gives card; email, but then eat you.
spokenText: Board to Death, Meeting: everyone gives card; email, but then eat you.

card.name: The Mole
card.power: Peek at everyone's hand. Reveal one card to the group.
card.lore: I'm not digging for worms. I'm digging for dirt.

line: The Mole, Peek at everyone's hand; digging for dirt, not worms.
spokenText: Before we continue, The Mole, Peek at everyone's hand; digging for dirt, not worms.

card.name: Double Agent
card.power: Play a card on someone else's turn. It counts as their move, but you choose the target.
card.lore: I'm on your side. And his side. Mostly my side.

line: Double Agent, Play on someone else's turn; their move, your target; mostly my side.
spokenText: Double Agent, Play on someone else's turn; their move, your target; mostly my side.

card.name: The Stool Pigeon
card.power: Name a card. If an opponent has it, they must discard it.
card.lore: I sing like a bird. Specifically, a bird who wants a plea deal.

line: The Stool Pigeon, Name card, opponent discards; sing like bird for plea deal.
spokenText: The Stool Pigeon, Name card, opponent discards; sing like bird for plea deal.

card.name: Dead Person Impersonation
card.power: Retrieve a card from the discard pile (the graveyard). Play it immediately.
card.lore: Reports of my death were greatly exaggerated to collect the insurance money.

line: Dead Person Impersonation, retrieve graveyard card; death exaggerated to collect insurance money.
spokenText: Not a metaphor: Dead Person Impersonation, retrieve graveyard card; death exaggerated to collect insurance money.

card.name: Betrayal by Offspring
card.power: Give one of your bad cards to a player with more points (your "parent").
card.lore: Thanks for the food, Mom. Now get out of my room/nest/kingdom.

line: Betrayal by Offspring, bad card to parent; thanks for food, Mom. Now get out of my kingdom.
spokenText: Betrayal by Offspring, bad card to parent; thanks for food, Mom. Now get out of my kingdom.

card.name: Parental Betrayal
card.power: Sacrifice a lower-value card to save a higher-value card.
card.lore: I brought you into this world, and I can take you out for a snack.

line: Parental Betrayal, sacrifice lower card for higher; I can take you out for snack.
spokenText: Parental Betrayal, sacrifice lower card for higher; I can take you out for snack.

card.name: Not Actually His Child
card.power: Reveal a secret. Force a player to swap their hand with the deck.
card.lore: He has your eyes. But he has the milkman's beak.

line: Not Actually His Child, reveal secret, swap hand with deck; he has your eyes, but milkman's beak.
spokenText: The thing about Not Actually His Child, reveal secret, swap hand with deck; he has your eyes, but milkman's beak.

card.name: Kinslaying
card.power: Eliminate a player who belongs to the same 'faction' or 'suit' as you.
card.lore: It's a special kind of evil. The kind that saves on holiday gifts.

line: Kinslaying, Same faction eliminated; evil saves on holiday gifts.
spokenText: Kinslaying, Same faction eliminated; evil saves on holiday gifts.

card.name: Love-Interest Traitor
card.power: If an opponent helps you, steal half their points next turn.
card.lore: Surprise! I was working for the Empire/Corporation/Ex-Boyfriend all along!

line: Love-Interest Traitor, Opponent helps, steal points; working for Empire all along.
spokenText: Love-Interest Traitor, Opponent helps, steal points; working for Empire all along.

card.name: The Honey Trap
card.power: Force a player to attack you. Reflect the damage back to them.
card.lore: It's not love. It's bioluminescent predatory bait. Easy mistake.

line: The Honey Trap, force attack, reflect damage; not love, bioluminescent predatory bait.
spokenText: Everyone agrees: The Honey Trap, force attack, reflect damage; not love, bioluminescent predatory bait.

card.name: Fair-Weather Friend
card.power: Abandon an ally during a challenge. You gain 2 points; they lose 2.
card.lore: I'm with you until the end. Or until it gets slightly inconvenient.

line: Fair-Weather Friend, Abandon ally for points; with you until slightly inconvenient.
spokenText: Fair-Weather Friend, Abandon ally for points; with you until slightly inconvenient.

card.name: Mistaken for Betrayal
card.power: Play a card that looks like an attack but actually heals someone.
card.lore: I was trying to save you! Why are you hitting me with a newspaper?

line: Mistaken for Betrayal, looks like attack, actually heals; why hitting me with newspaper?
spokenText: Mistaken for Betrayal, looks like attack, actually heals; why hitting me with newspaper?

card.name: Face-Heel Turn
card.power: Switch from "Good" to "Evil." All your healing cards become damage cards.
card.lore: Being a good boy was boring. I want to chew the furniture.

line: Face-Heel Turn? Good to Evil, healing into damage; chew furniture.
spokenText: Have you heard of Face-Heel Turn? Good to Evil, healing into damage; chew furniture.

card.name: Heel-Face Turn
card.power: Switch from 'Evil' to 'Good': All your Damage cards become healing cards.

note: Print p.9 shows title and stats only, no power and no lore. JSON power is not printed (WS0 data issue).

card.name: Going Native
card.power: Adopt the special ability of the player to your left.
card.lore: I find their culture superior. Also, the shrimp is better here.

line: Going Native, Adopt ability of player to left; shrimp better here.
spokenText: Going Native, Adopt ability of player to left; shrimp better here.

card.name: The Quisling
card.power: Help an opponent win a challenge against your own team.
card.lore: I welcome our new insect-eating overlords.

line: The Quisling, Help opponent against own team; new insect-eating overlords.
spokenText: The Quisling, Help opponent against own team; new insect-eating overlords.

card.name: Trojan Horse
card.power: Give a gift card to an opponent. When they flip it, they lose 3 cards.
card.lore: Beware of Greeks bearing gifts. Also beware of Mice bearing giant wooden Cats.

line: Trojan Horse, Gift card, opponent loses cards; Greeks bearing gifts, wooden Cats.
spokenText: Let me tell you about Trojan Horse, Gift card, opponent loses cards; Greeks bearing gifts, wooden Cats.

card.name: Lured Into a Trap
card.power: Play a high-value card face down. If someone attacks it, they are eliminated.
card.lore: It looked delicious. It tasted like a snapped spine.

line: Lured Into a Trap, High-value card face down; looked delicious, snapped spine.
spokenText: Lured Into a Trap, High-value card face down; looked delicious, snapped spine.

card.name: False Innocence Trick
card.power: Negate an accusation. The accuser must apologize and discard a card.
card.lore: Who, me? I'm just a lil' guy. You wouldn't hit a lil' guy.

line: False Innocence Trick, Negate accusation; who me, just a lil' guy.
spokenText: False Innocence Trick, Negate accusation; who me, just a lil' guy.

card.name: Nasty Party
card.power: Invite all players to roll a die. Lowest roll is executed.
card.lore: The Red Wedding was a bit much, but the catering was exquisite.

line: Nasty Party, Lowest roll executed; Red Wedding catering exquisite.
spokenText: This one has a rule: Nasty Party, Lowest roll executed; Red Wedding catering exquisite.

card.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
card.power: Select an opponent. Both choose "Snitch" or "Silent." Snitch/Silent = Snitch wins big. Both Snitch = Both lose.
card.lore: If I talk, I walk. If we both talk, we cook.

line: Prisoner's Dilemma, Snitch or Silent; if both talk, we cook.
spokenText: Prisoner's Dilemma, Snitch or Silent; if both talk, we cook.

card.name: I Surrender, Suckers!
card.power: Cancel combat. Then, immediately attack for double damage.
card.lore: White flag? No, that's just a napkin I'm using to wipe the floor with you.

line: I Surrender, Suckers!, Cancel combat, then double damage; white flag, just napkin.
spokenText: I Surrender, Suckers!, Cancel combat, then double damage; white flag, just napkin.

card.name: Rash Equilibrium
card.power: No one can attack anyone until your next turn.
card.lore: If I move, you shoot. If you shoot, he shoots. Let's just stand here and die of thirst.

line: Rash Equilibrium, No attacks until next turn; stand here and die of thirst.
spokenText: Nobody warned us about Rash Equilibrium, No attacks until next turn; stand here and die of thirst.

card.name: The Gambit
card.power: Sacrifice your best card to automatically win the game in 3 turns (unless you die first).
card.lore: I lost the battle to win the war. And the parking space.

line: The Gambit, sacrifice best card to win; lost battle to win war. And parking space.
spokenText: The Gambit, sacrifice best card to win; lost battle to win war. And parking space.

card.name: Thirty Pieces of Silver
card.power: Sell out an ally for 5 resource tokens.
card.lore: The price of loyalty is surprisingly affordable in this economy.

line: Thirty Pieces of Silver, sell out ally; loyalty surprisingly affordable in this economy.
spokenText: Thirty Pieces of Silver, sell out ally; loyalty surprisingly affordable in this economy.

card.name: Poisoned Chalice
card.power: Offer a card to a player. If they accept, they die.
card.lore: A toast! To your health... or lack thereof.

line: Poisoned Chalice, Offer card, accept and die; toast to health or lack.
spokenText: The deck insists on Poisoned Chalice, Offer card, accept and die; toast to health or lack.

card.name: Lying Finger Cross
card.power: Retroactively cancel a deal you made last turn.
card.lore: It doesn't count if my digits were intertwined. International law.

line: Lying Finger Cross, cancel deal; doesn't count if digits intertwined. International law.
spokenText: Lying Finger Cross, cancel deal; doesn't count if digits intertwined. International law.

card.name: Burner Phone
card.power: Contact a player secretly. Swap cards under the table.
card.lore: New number, who dis? Don't answer, I'm already gone.

line: Burner Phone, Secret contact, swap cards; new number, already gone.
spokenText: Burner Phone, Secret contact, swap cards; new number, already gone.

card.name: The Scapegoat
card.power: Transfer all damage you take this turn to another player.
card.lore: It wasn't me! It was the guy with the horns! (Wait, I have horns).

line: The Scapegoat, Transfer damage to another player; guy with horns, I have horns.
spokenText: Which brings us to The Scapegoat, Transfer damage to another player; guy with horns, I have horns.

card.name: Cannon Fodder
card.power: Block an attack by discarding a 'Minion' card.
card.lore: Their bravery is matched only by their expendability.

line: Cannon Fodder, Discard Minion to block; bravery matched by expendability.
spokenText: Cannon Fodder, Discard Minion to block; bravery matched by expendability.

card.name: Shoot the Messenger
card.power: If someone plays a card you don't like, discard a card from their hand.
card.lore: Bad news is a capital offense.

line: Shoot the Messenger, Discard card from their hand; bad news capital offense.
spokenText: Shoot the Messenger, Discard card from their hand; bad news capital offense.

card.name: You Have Outlived Your Usefulness
card.power: Eliminate your own ally to gain their strength stats.
card.lore: The job is done. And so are you.

line: You Have Outlived Your Usefulness? Eliminate own ally; job is done, and so are you.
spokenText: Do you know You Have Outlived Your Usefulness? Eliminate own ally; job is done, and so are you.

card.name: Sixth Ranger Traitor
card.power: Join a team. Betray them immediately for bonus points.
card.lore: Go Go Power Traitors! I was evil since the opening credits!

line: Sixth Ranger Traitor, Join team, betray immediately; evil since opening credits.
spokenText: Sixth Ranger Traitor, Join team, betray immediately; evil since opening credits.

card.name: Evil All Along
card.power: Reveal your true form. Discard your hand and draw 5 new cards.
card.lore: I wasn't shy. I was cocooning my rage.

line: Evil All Along, true form, new hand; I wasn't shy, I was cocooning my rage.
spokenText: Evil All Along, true form, new hand; I wasn't shy, I was cocooning my rage.

card.name: Manchurian Candidate
card.power: Activate a 'Sleeper' agent. Take control of another player's next turn.
card.lore: When you hear the word 'Omelette', kill the Prime Minister.

line: Manchurian Candidate, activate Sleeper? When you hear Omelette, kill Prime Minister.
spokenText: Did you hear of Manchurian Candidate, activate Sleeper? When you hear Omelette, kill Prime Minister.

card.name: The Corruptible
card.power: If an opponent offers you a card, you must join their team.
card.lore: I have morals. But I also really like mud.

line: The Corruptible, offered card, join their team; I have morals, but really like mud.
spokenText: The Corruptible, offered card, join their team; I have morals, but really like mud.

card.name: Et Tu, Brute?
card.power: If your best friend attacks you, they instantly win. You die of heartbreak.
card.lore: Then fall, Fido.

line: Et Tu, Brute?, best friend attacks, instantly wins; you die of heartbreak. Then fall, Fido.
spokenText: Et Tu, Brute?, best friend attacks, instantly wins; you die of heartbreak. Then fall, Fido.

card.name: The Vendetta
card.power: Target a player who hurt you 5 turns ago. Eliminate them.
card.lore: Elephants never forget. And we never forgive.

line: The Vendetta, Target player who hurt you 5 turns ago; elephants never forget.
spokenText: Welcome to The Vendetta, Target player who hurt you 5 turns ago; elephants never forget.

card.name: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!
card.power: Play when someone betrays you. Shout the card title. Steal their shoes.
card.lore: We knew it was coming. We just hoped it would wait until after dessert.

spokenTitle: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!
line: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!, Betrayed, shout title, steal shoes
spokenText: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!, Betrayed, shout title, steal shoes

card.name: Regretful Traitor
card.power: Sacrifice yourself to save another player. (Redemption Arc).
card.lore: I won. But at what cost? Oh right, the cost was everyone else.

line: Regretful Traitor, Sacrifice yourself to save another; I won, at what cost?
spokenText: Regretful Traitor, Sacrifice yourself to save another; I won, at what cost?
